tests.title: Order matters: ")(" is invalid
tests.fail_why: Solo comparaste que el total de '(' y ')' fuera igual. ')(' tiene el mismo conteo pero es inválida.
tests.fail_how: Revisa el contador en CADA paso: si baja de 0, hay un cierre sin apertura y la respuesta es false de inmediato.
tests.fail_why_en: You only compared that the total of '(' and ')' was equal. ')(' has the same count but is invalid.
tests.fail_how_en: Check the counter at EVERY step: if it drops below 0 there is a closing without an opening and the answer is false immediately.

tests.title: Handles empty string and single brackets
tests.fail_why: Falla con vacío o un solo paréntesis.
tests.fail_how: Al final debe cumplirse open == 0 (no solo 'nunca fue negativo').
tests.fail_why_en: Fails with empty input or a single parenthesis.
tests.fail_how_en: At the end open == 0 must hold (not just 'it was never negative').

tests.title: O(n): works with 5,000,000 characters
tests.fail_why: No es lineal o consume memoria extra.
tests.fail_how: Un solo recorrido con un int.
tests.fail_why_en: It is not linear or it uses extra memory.
tests.fail_how_en: A single pass with one int.

tests.title: Uses O(1) space: no collections or arrays
tests.fail_why: Usaste una pila, lista o arreglo, y el enunciado pide O(1) de espacio.
tests.fail_how: Para un solo tipo de paréntesis basta un contador. La pila solo hace falta con varios tipos ( ) [ ] { }.
tests.fail_why_en: You used a stack, list or array, and the statement asks for O(1) space.
tests.fail_how_en: For a single kind of parenthesis a counter is enough. A stack is only needed with several kinds ( ) [ ] { }.
